name: General Agent
blurb: A balanced daily driver: cross-session continuity and a curated identity on top of the stock Hebbian defaults.

name: Research Scholar
blurb: Deep-research memory: strict attestation, a live relation graph with a small local triple model, aggressive consolidation cadence, and a large long tier.

name: Overnight Knowledge Engine
blurb: The batch-trainer tuning that built a 2000-fact expert overnight: long reason timeouts for cloud flagships, unlimited long tier, relation triples offloaded to a small local model, procedural conflict sweeps on.

name: Low-VRAM Homelab
blurb: Everything on one small card: a 3B reasoner kept warm, fewer and lighter LLM passes, trimmed recall context.

name: Conspiracy Theorist (fun)
blurb: Everything connects, man. Clustering thresholds on the floor, four-hop inference chains, and conflict detection told to look the other way. Pedagogical: this is what the conflict and clustering dials are protecting you from.

name: Goldfish (fun)
blurb: Lives entirely in the moment. Brutal decay, one-cycle tiers, a 25-fact long-term memory, and instant deletion at zero resonance. Pedagogical: watch the retention dials matter.
